shellCommands.command: ls -R app | head -50 && cat next.config.ts tsconfig.json && node -e "console.log(require('./node_modules/next/package.json').version)"

grep -rn "deprecat" node_modules/next/dist/build/index.js 2>/dev/null | grep -i "middleware\|proxy" | head -10; echo "---"; grep -rn "middleware.*deprecat\|deprecat.*middleware" node_modules/next/dist/lib/*.js node_modules/next/dist/build/*.js 2>/dev/null | head -10

grep -rn "ProxyConfig\|NextProxy\|export type Proxy\|type Proxy " node_modules/next/dist/server/web/types.d.ts | head -20; echo "=== server.d.ts ==="; cat node_modules/next/server.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -30

grep -rn "mod.proxy\|mod.middleware\|\.default\b" node_modules/next/dist/build/webpack/loaders/next-middleware-loader.js 2>/dev/null | head; echo "=== loader src ==="; grep -rn "proxy\|middleware" node_modules/next/dist/build/webpack/loaders/next-middleware-loader.js | head -30
grep -rn "isProxy" node_modules/next/dist/build/templates/middleware.js | head -5; echo "=== codemod ==="; ls node_modules/@next/codemod/dist/transforms/ 2>/dev/null | grep -i proxy

(npx next dev --port 3117 > /tmp/dev.log 2>&1 &) ; for i in $(seq 1 40); do sleep 1; if grep -q "Ready\|started server\|Local:" /tmp/dev.log 2>/dev/null; then break; fi; done; sleep 2; echo "=== HEADERS / ==="; curl -s -D - -o /dev/null http://localhost:3117/ | grep -i "HTTP/\|x-request-id"; echo "=== HEADERS /about ==="; curl -s -D - -o /dev/null http://localhost:3117/about | grep -i "HTTP/\|x-request-id"
grep -n "8377ac9d\|6f29f5fe" /tmp/dev.log; echo "=== warnings? ==="; grep -in "deprecat" /tmp/dev.log | head -3; echo "=== build ==="; npx next build 2>&1 | tail -20
